industry: Outdoor living construction and hardscape (decks, patios, pavers, outdoor kitchens, pergolas/patio covers, fire features, decorative concrete, related outdoor structures)
words_and_claims_to_avoid: 'Licensed/insured/bonded' if not currently true — print license number where state ads require it
'Starting at $X' based on a stripped project nobody buys without disclosing what that price includes
Unsubstantiated 'maintenance-free forever' / 50-year durability without manufacturer+install proof
'HOA approved' / 'permits included' if not true for the job
Fake storm or 'last build slot this year' urgency
Financing-first headlines that make the project feel like debt (roofing-round5 directional) without clear outcome
'$X/month' or '0% / no payments until…' without Reg Z required disclosures when triggering terms appear
Government inspection / permit-office look-alike mailers (39 USC 3001)
Before/after that exaggerate typical results without context
compliance_notes: Print contractor license numbers where the state requires them in advertising; client confirms their state rule.
FTC Act / 16 CFR 233: discounts and package prices need bona fide reference prices and clear scope (size, materials, exclusions).
'Starting at' / fixed package prices (e.g., 14x16 patio for $4998): define inclusions/exclusions so the price is not a bait.
Wood/composite/paver durability and warranty claims must match manufacturer and installer warranties actually offered.
HOA/permit: say 'we help with permits' only if true; never claim HOA approval before review.
Financing: 12 CFR 1026.24 — payment amount, finance charge, down payment, or number of payments can trigger required APR and term disclosures; state only terms actually available.
FTC Cooling-Off Rule (16 CFR 429): covered in-home sales $25+ generally need the 3-business-day cancel notice in the contract; states may add longer windows.
16 CFR 251: free design consult / free estimate conditions disclosed if purchase required.
39 USC 3001: no official city permit or inspection notice look-alikes.
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: desire, pride, mild calendar urgency, relief are fine when legal.
Every angle and emotion_by_offer combo carries sell_the_outcome_line.
Vendor ROI labeled agency-only unverified; never print as fact on a client card.
Prefer one finished outdoor hero + one offer + one QR (roofing-round5 directional).

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Patrick votes (directional): keep financing secondary to outdoor outcome; still obey Reg Z if terms appear.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: 'Starting at' / package prices vs typical upgraded jobs
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Compliance: define inclusions; do not bait with an unavailable configuration.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Landscaping playbook patterns vs outdoor-living specificity
